title: Looks like the circus is in town?
content: The fing circus was in town last night at the fing mall! Im so tired of dreaming about being at this damned mall for real 😅🥲 its EVERY night at this point 🥴 they had set up a huge big top amidst a roundabout of kiosks and i knew a show was about to start and wanted to see it so i went to the pisser and there was a huge line for the mens since all of the circus folks were males apparently. Womens rooms were plentiful and not being used so i squeezed into one and the door was broken. Strong men were standing in line, clowns, jugglers, the whole shebang. And i said to myself this is all so appropriate bc this place is a fucking circus, before waking up of course. What is going on in there 🥲🥲🥲😅😅😅
